title: Toll Return Timeliness Factors, Wayfare Rides
content:
The toll timeliness factor of a detour toll return on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** counts the calendar days from the charge date of the toll to today — the date on the trip's toll charge, not the date of the fare.

| Calendar days from the toll charge date to today | Toll timeliness factor |
|---|---|
| fewer than 8 | not reduced |
| at least 8 (mid toll days), fewer than 21 | 0.85 (mid toll timeliness factor) |
| 21 or more (late toll days) | 0.6 (late toll timeliness factor) |

At least 21 days take the late toll timeliness factor of 0.6; at least 8 days but fewer than 21 take the mid toll timeliness factor of 0.85; fewer than 8 days leave the factor unreduced.

## Either side of each line (hypothetical; toll charged on 2 February)

| Today | Days | Factor |
|---|---|---|
| 9 February | 7 | not reduced |
| 10 February | 8 | 0.85 |
| 22 February | 20 | 0.85 |
| 23 February | 21 | 0.6 |
